subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be limited to documenting current multiline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported user-configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a configurable preference would create new public TUI config/keybinding surface in a repo with a high bar for new configuration.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback in docs and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow supported keybinding/config shape for send/newline behavior with compatibility docs and focused tests.

options.title: Defer Configurable Keybindings
options.body: Keep this issue open for demand tracking but avoid adding config until broader TUI keybinding policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback in docs and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact issue and are the clearest current routing signal for the TUI product decision.
